thread:
ops: @here FYI — planned rolling bridge maintenance next Tue 24 Mar, 02:00-03:00 UTC. This is a network bridge upgrade that will be applied region-by-region. Expect 4-10m of brief TCP connection resets per region while we rekey and migrate routes. No data migrations. Posting planned comms and handoff below. :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance created — ID MNT-20260324-bridge. Reminder windows: 48h, 1h, 10m before start. Auto-pager suppression enabled for non-critical alerts during window.

alex_r: Quick technical summary: rolling bridge firmware + route-table reconciliation. Canary in us-west1 (~02:00-02:10), then us-east1, eu-west1. Each region is expected to see connection resets when existing TCP sessions remap to new bridge — streaming gRPC and long-polling clients may see short reconnects. We'll circulate a compatibility header so SDKs can auto-retry.

maria_s: I drafted the statuspage + customer email. Status draft: "Planned maintenance: brief connection resets expected. No data loss. Services will remain available with automatic retries." Link (internal draft): https://docs.redwood.internal/statuspage/drafts/MNT-bridge-20260324 

katie_c: Can we mitigate for hosted API customers with active streaming? Any possibility to route active streams to a warm node to avoid resets?

eng-sre: Short answer: partial. We have an edge fallback that will attempt the previous bridge for 30s if handshake fails, and our client-side SDKs have 2s jittered reconnects by default. For really sensitive customers we can enable session pinning for the window — that requires a config flip (edge.pin_sessions=true) per region. We'll coordinate with Dedicated seats separately.

ops: Handoff plan and runbook:
- 01:30 UTC: final preflight check (heatmaps, circuit-breaker thresholds).
- 01:45 UTC: post customer 1h reminder (maria_s).
- 02:00 UTC: canary in us-west1 (alex_r owns). Monitor 02:00-02:10, validate error budget, latency.
- 02:15 UTC: proceed to us-east1 (maria_s owns).
- 02:40 UTC: proceed to eu-west1 (katie_c owns).
- 02:55 UTC: finish and post completion.

Runbook snippets (paste into #eng-oncall when starting):
```
# quick checks
curl -sS https://health.redwood/api/region/us-west1 | jq .status
curl -sS https://edge-metrics.internal/bridges | grep us-west1
# toggle session pin (ops tool)
ops-cli config set edge.pin_sessions true --region us-west1
```

alex_r: During canary I'll watch 5xx rate, open file descriptors, and tail the bridge syslog: `ssh root@bridge-canary 'tail -n 200 /var/log/bridge.log'`. If 5xx > 0.5% or reconnects spike >3x baseline, abort and rollback (ops-cli rollback MNT-20260324-bridge --region us-west1).

maria_s: Customer comms plan:
- 48h notice (sent) — contains impact summary + support guidance.
- 1h reminder (I'll send + include link to streaming SDK retry config).
- Real-time status updates during the window: minute-by-minute in this thread + statuspage.
- Post-completion email with details and contact for escalations.

katie_c: Account teams — please flag any high-risk customers (financial, healthcare) so we can individually coordinate an alternate window or bespoke mitigation. Mentioning @accounts in the follow-up.

eng-sre: Minor detail: please ensure KV-cache TTLs are extended to avoid cache misses during the bridge switchover. Config key: `cache.frontend.prefix_ttl=120s` — we'll bump to 600s for 1 hour.

ops: Template for statuspage update (post when canary begins):
- Status: Degradation (during canary) / Maintenance
- Impact: Brief connection resets for a subset of requests in us-west1. Automatic retries should restore client sessions.
- ETA: 02:00-03:00 UTC.
- More info: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/MNT-20260324 

maria_s: I'll post the 1h reminder at 01:00 UTC. Also prepping the email for channel account managers to send to affected customers.

oncall-bot: Reminder: 01:30 UTC preflight in #eng-oncall (automated).

alex_r: Live checks to paste into thread after canary start: p50/p95 token latency, 5xx rate, streaming reconnect rate, edge CPU, bridge syslog tail. Example quick query: `promql 'rate(http_requests_total{region="us-west1",code=~"5.."}[2m])'`

statusbot: Statuspage update posted to draft: https://status.redwood.ai/drafts/MNT-20260324 (will publish on ops confirm).

ops: Post-canary update (02:09 UTC): Canary completed in us-west1. Observed reconnect spike ~2.1x baseline for ~90s, 5xx stayed below 0.2%. Proceeding to us-east1. :white_check_mark:

maria_s: us-east1 in progress (02:18 UTC) — posting live status update now. Keeping the customer-facing note conservative: "Minor transient disconnects for some streaming requests; automatic retries will recover sessions."

katie_c: eu-west1 start (02:35 UTC). I'm watching a couple of enterprise accounts that requested extended pinning — those were enabled before the region flip.

ops: Completion note (02:58 UTC): Rolling bridge upgrade completed across all regions. No data loss, no customer reports escalated to SEV. Postmortem and config diffs will be posted to the infra repo. Please keep thread open for 24h for late regressions. :white_check_mark:

statusbot: Public statuspage published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/MNT-20260324 — status: Completed.

eng-sre: Post-checklist: revert `edge.pin_sessions` to previous value, reduce cache TTL back to 120s after 1 hour, and run canary smoke tests for 6h to validate steady-state.

katie_c: Thanks everyone — good coordination. I'll follow up with the email to accounts and close my manual tasks.

ops: Closing internal ops thread in 24h unless someone asks to keep it open. Great job team. :tada:
